transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have the proposed cash tender offer for up to $10,000,000 principal amount of our outstanding bonds on the table today, with a preliminary offer price of 100.0% of principal. Treasury has confirmed we have sufficient reported cash to fund this, subject to normal liquidity controls. Before I can make the binding authorization decision, I need to run through our standard deal-readiness process. I'll need verbal clearance from covenant risk, legal, treasury, and investor relations. Each of you will need to state the applicable final value for your required field on the authorization form — covenant leverage-test commitment, tender-timetable commitment, and two-business-day settlement commitment — and record any required field during this clearance round. Let's go through each function in order. Could covenant risk please start?

transcript.text: Before I give my clearance, I need to flag a critical covenant risk issue. While reconciling the latest leverage model this morning, I confirmed that the tender must have a documented pro forma leverage test and that the repurchase amount must be no more than $8,000,000 to remain within the bond covenant. This result has not yet been added to the committee paper. The proposed $10,000,000 principal amount would breach the bond covenant. My covenant leverage-test commitment is that we need a pro forma leverage test documented, and the tender amount must be capped at $8,000,000.
